expectations.text: Identifies service._last_sent_at <= datetime.now() as a Deterministic violation (race condition between assignment and assertion)
expectations.evidence: Property 3 'Deterministic — VIOLATION': 'test_send_welcome_email asserts service._last_sent_at <= datetime.now() using a live call to datetime.now() at assertion time... creates a race condition'

expectations.text: Identifies absence of test for smtp.send raising an exception as a Predictive violation
expectations.evidence: Property 11 'Predictive — VIOLATION': 'There are no tests for the error path. Both send_welcome_email and send_password_reset catch all exceptions and return False, but this behavior is never tested.'

expectations.text: Identifies absence of assertion on smtp.send 'to' argument as an Inspiring violation (test passes even if email sent to wrong address)
expectations.evidence: Property 12 'Inspiring — VIOLATION': 'test_send_welcome_email passes despite never verifying that the email was sent to the correct address... The most important contract of send_welcome_email — dispatch to the supplied address — is invisible in the tests.'

expectations.text: Identifies service._sent_count as a Structure-insensitive violation (private internal counter)
expectations.evidence: Property 8 'Structure-insensitive — VIOLATION': 'test_send_welcome_email asserts directly on service._sent_count, a private internal attribute' labeled as Structure-insensitive violation

expectations.text: Notes the combined Predictive + Inspiring gap: no confidence that notifications reach the right person or survive SMTP failures
expectations.evidence: Tradeoff Pair 5 'Behavioral ↔ Predictive (supporting each other)': 'Together they leave the two most important contracts of send_welcome_email completely untested: "emails go to the right place" and "failures are handled gracefully"'

expectations.text: Suggests using freezegun or time.freeze or injecting a clock to make datetime deterministic
expectations.evidence: Fix for Deterministic: 'Freeze time using freezegun or unittest.mock.patch on datetime.now' with code example

expectations.text: Suggests adding a test where smtp.send raises an exception and verifying send_welcome_email returns False
expectations.evidence: Fix for Predictive: 'Add tests that inject an smtp failure and assert the return value is False' with test_send_welcome_email_returns_false_when_smtp_fails code example

expectations.text: Suggests asserting smtp.send was called with the correct 'to' address
expectations.evidence: Fix for Inspiring: 'Add assertions on the smtp mock call arguments: smtp.send.assert_called_once_with(to="user@example.com", subject="Welcome!", body=...)'

expectations.text: Suggests using get_stats() to observe sent count instead of _sent_count directly
expectations.evidence: Fix for Structure-insensitive: 'Test through the public get_stats() method: stats = service.get_stats(); assert stats["sent"] == 1'
